visual_rejections: Do not use the metallicity-versus-redshift literature scatter in this census explainer.
Do not render internal paths or filenames as audience citations.
Do not make 62 look like a terminal eligible sample.
Do not draw 62 in series as a filter feeding T2; T2 applies to all 157.
Do not omit the single-table scope or imply that cross-table joins and crossmatches were assessed.
Do not hide the 19/2 dropped-row reasons inside body prose.
Do not call abundance-search-, mass-search-, or redshift-search-axis metadata reach an adjudicated physical measurement.
Do not conflate T1's three retrieval controls with T2 contract-design controls; if T2 control counts are shown, display all 12 decoys and 3 anchors together and label them NOT ELIGIBILITY RESULTS.
Do not publish internally derived count graphics without an audience-reachable methods and count ledger.
Do not leave a substantive scientific evidence state unchanged for more than three seconds or use standalone section-divider holds; map every substantive narration clause to a visible reveal.
Do not use full-frame scientific resets between beats; preserve declared state handoffs, the main 178→−21→157→T2 spine, the 62 parent boundary, and workflow-stage identity.
Do not call the archive census a metallicity measurement or flagship galaxy-evolution study.
